transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI's artificial intelligence accessed a crypto wallet in October 2026, exposing risks of public recovery phrases in crypto development, reported by OneSafe.
Nvidia's stock drops 1.43 percent as artificial intelligence stocks fall, amid the CEO's optimistic outlook, reported by 新浪网.
Anthropic traced NIST curve seeds to 1990s C code, offering a reproducible origin for cryptographic standards, reported by Bitcoin Foundation.
Bill Gates expands an artificial intelligence safety push after concerns over rising capabilities and weak regulation, reported by The Next Web.
Anomaly's OpenCode breach exposes API keys, prompting key rotations and industry-wide artificial intelligence security concerns, reported by Startup Fortune.
